rule_statement: One increase per 12 months on anniversary date
notes: Anniversary = lease start or last increase date. Moving date forfeits unaged bank (see R04).

rule_statement: 60% of CPI change capped at 7% max
notes: Official code Sec 37.3(a)(1). Each Mar 1 Board publishes figure based on U.S. Dept Labor CPI.

rule_statement: Rent Increase License required before annual/banked increase takes effect
limit_or_formula: Must report to Housing Inventory per Sec 37.15 effective July 1 2022 (condos/1-9 units Mar 1 2023)
notes: Unlicensed increase is null and void — critical for review.

rule_statement: Unused annual increase may be accumulated and added later
limit_or_formula: Additive not compound sum of unused percentages No cap on total banked at once Must list years/amounts in notice

rule_statement: Changing anniversary can lose banked year
limit_or_formula: 12 months must elapse before bank available; early anniversary move loses unaged bank
notes: SF.gov example: May 1 increase loses June 1 2025 1.4% because not yet 12 months old.

rule_statement: Cannot round up to nearest dollar
Cannot charge extra for lawful additional roommate/occupant
limit_or_formula: Prohibited even if lease says so

rule_statement: 30-day written notice if increase ≤10% in 12 mo 90-day if >10%
limit_or_formula: +5 days if mailed per Civ 827 Use percentage in effect on effective date not serve date

rule_statement: Capital improvements and O&M require Board certification before increase
limit_or_formula: Capital 100% certified costs capped 10% or $30/yr O&M capped 7% utility passthroughs 2yr filing Hardship stay available
notes: Secondary SF Tenants Union summary; primary is Ordinance Sec 37.7/37.3 — flagged as practitioner summary not code fetch.

rule_statement: No limit on initial rent for vacant covered unit
notes: Under Overview: no limit on first charge to new tenant in vacant covered unit.

rule_statement: Housing Inventory fees may be passed partially
notes: Current Rates table includes Rent Board Fees bankable.
